lead.title: Cities in the Metaverse
lead.sub: Spatial Computing, Digital Twins, Avatars, Economics and Digital Habitation on the New Frontier
lead.authors: Andrew Hudson-Smith, Duncan Wilson & Valerio Signorelli
lead.blurb: A multidisciplinary account of where urban environments meet digital ones — from early cyberspace concepts through spatial computing to digital habitation, including the worlds already abandoned and what they teach.

forthcoming.title: Digital Cities of Tomorrow — Planning in the Digital Age
forthcoming.blurb: Where digital twins, autonomous systems and habitation meet the everyday city.

forthcoming.title: Digital Urban
forthcoming.blurb: Two decades of the blog, the builds and the research it came from.

little.title: The Little Book of Public Space and the Internet of Things
little.authors: Alexandra Deschamps-Sonsino, Andrew Hudson-Smith & Duncan Wilson, edited by Paul Coulton
little.blurb: Public spaces are at the front of a technological revolution that mostly stays out of sight. Safety and security, maintenance, health, community, play, conservation, transport, accessibility — and where it goes next.

little.title: The Little Book of Connected Environments and the Internet of Things
little.authors: Andrew Hudson-Smith, Duncan Wilson, Duncan Hay & Steven Gray
little.blurb: Opening up what IoT devices can tell us about our environment, through case studies: Shazam for Bats, Tales of the Park, and the Internet of Schools.

booklet.title: Digital Geography
booklet.blurb: An illustrated guide to visualising urban environments — from data and imagery to three-dimensional city models and the tools used to build them.
